text:
Sam: Quick pantry PSA: someone left a half-open jar of fig jam on the top shelf. It attracted ants this morning. Please put lids back on and date opened. :ant:
Jules: Oh no, thanks for flagging. Which shelf? I can clean it if you point it out.
Sam: Top left, behind the cereal boxes. I moved the jar to the sink and put a sticky note.
Nora: Also, coffee etiquette reminder: if you run the cold brew tap, please purge for 10s before filling your bottle. The reservoir gets funky. :coffee:
coffee-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Kitchen check" at 4:30pm daily. Auto-notify for dirty mugs.
Jules: Question: can we have a small communal marker set? Labelled markers would save confusion when people write dates.
Sam: Great idea. I put a pack of fine-tip markers in the cutlery drawer. Please return them after use.
Nora: Heads up: yogurt Tupperware in fridge with no name. If you stashed it, claim by EOD or it becomes team snack. :eyes:
Jules: That's mine, sorry! I'll label and take it after standup.
Sam: Also doing a quick snack run at 3:30. Anything specific? I can grab almond butter, oat cookies, and lemon sparkling water.
Nora: Oat cookies please. And if you see the dark chocolate peanut bars, grab two (one for me). If peanuts are an issue for anyone, skip them.
Jules: Could you grab a box of decaf pods too? We have been running low.
Sam: Got it: oat cookies, almond butter, decaf pods, lemon seltzer. Anything else?
Nora: No, thanks! Oh and maybe a small sign for the cold-brew tap so new hires know to purge. :memo:
Sam: Will do. I'll print a tiny sticker and stick it above the tap.
coffee-bot: Note: please dispose of any opened produce in the shared compost bucket before end of day.
